notes: 1908 narrow three-storey flats, pink rough-cast stucco with cream trim. Ground: arched wood entry up a stoop at left, a four-lite window right of centre, a small side door at the right end, dark grey-brown base band. Uppers: paired sash windows left and right sharing a shallow railed fire-escape balcony, bracketed cornice over the ground storey. Salmon wall, rusticated pink ground storey (hyDRubble), pink fire escape, full-width projecting box bay on the upper storeys, arched surround on the stoop door. Dark plinth not separable from the pink band, SKIPPED. Tint lift (2026-10-02): paint tints lifted toward the sunlit paint (t' = 1-(1-t)k); brick tints converted to target / kit colour. GroundBand lift (2026-10-03): groundBand tint #d6a090 -> #ead0c8 (same rule as walls; it was missed by the first colour pass).
